name: keep-awake-toggle
title: Keep awake toggle
description: A switch that keeps the screen on for recipes, scripts and slides with the Wake Lock API, taking it again after a tab switch.
docs: The lock is requested when the switch is turned on, requested again when the tab becomes visible (browsers let go of it while a tab is hidden) and released when it is turned off or the page goes. Nothing is requested on load: a switch that starts on (defaultOn or on) asks for the lock at the first touch or key press. If the browser refuses, the switch returns to off, onChange(false) is called and one line says why. Where the Wake Lock API does not exist the component renders nothing. Pass wakeLock to supply your own source.
